subject: Error: Failed to create the shared library in LINUX

messages.author: 3c63f9c1edd3192f
messages.subject: Error: Failed to create the shared library in LINUX
parts:
Hi!  I use the linux system in the server and the gcc version is 7.0.0, the R version is 4.0.1. The package nimble was successfully downloaded but for the C++ compiling step, I kept having the “Error: Failed to create the shared library.” message.

I am working through the “Lightening Introduction” in the user manual and got stuck at section 2.3. When trying to compile the model (`compileNimble`), I get the following error:

“Error: Failed to create the shared library.”

Could you please help with that?

When I printed the error, it says “make: *** [dynamicRegistrations_08_19_14_56_29.o] Error 1”

This was done using the Linux system, I did not find any solution in the user manual for Linux. Any suggestions would be appreciated!

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Error: Failed to create the shared library in LINUX
parts:
Hi Ziqiao, I'm following up here rather than in your other email to us.  In that other email, you reported the error message below.
I'm not sure what the issue is, but it doesn't look like anything directly related to nimble given the error comes in syntax in
stringfwd.h. Perhaps there is a problem with the installation of your C/C++ compiler. Do you have a systems administrator
maintaining this Linux server? That sysadmin might be able to help.

Alternatively, if you maintain the machine, you might try re-installing gcc.

-chris

> library(nimble)
> code <- nimbleCode({
+   y ~ dnorm(0,1)
+ })
> model <- nimbleModel(code)
> cModel <- compileNimble(model, showCompilerOutput = TRUE)
compiling... this may take a minute. On some systems there may be some compiler warnings that can be safely ignored.
Error: Failed to create the shared library.

                 from /home/zwang21/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.0/nimble/include/nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h:27,
                 from dynamicRegistrations_08_20_09_42_27.cpp:1:
/software/x86_64/GCC/7.0.0-rhel7/include/c++/7.0.0/bits/stringfwd.h:67:1: error: ‘_GLIBCXX_BEGIN_NAMESPACE_CXX11’ does not name a type
 _GLIBCXX_BEGIN_NAMESPACE_CXX11
 ^
